title: On an asymmetric additive energy inequality
summary: Let $d \geq 1$ be an integer, $G$ be an abelian group and $ν, w_1, \dots, w_{2d}: G \to [0, \infty)$ be functions with finite, non-empty supports. Define the generalised additive energy \[ E_{2d, ν}(w_1, \dots, w_{2d}) = \sum_{y,y' \in G}\sum_{a_1, \dots, a_{2d} \in G } w_1(a_1) \dots w_{2d}(a_{2d}) ν(y) ν(y') 1_{\sum_{i=1}^d (a_i - a_{i+d}) = y-y'} .\] Moreover, for every $1 \leq i \leq 2d$, let $E_{2d, ν}(w_i) = E_{2d, ν}(w_i, \dots, w_i)$. A standard Fourier analytic argument delivers the estimate \[ E_{2d,ν}(w_1, \dots, w_{2d}) \leq \prod_{1 \leq i \leq 2d} E_{2d, ν}(w_i)^{1/2d}.\] In…
